plugins.name: check-gate
plugins.description: Mod: reruns the repo's check after code changes and stops git commit while it fails.

plugins.name: citation-guard
plugins.description: Mod for warhammer: asks for a CITATIONS.md entry when an edit changes a game value.

plugins.name: boe-guard
plugins.description: Mod for boe-agent: refuses whole reads of the long docs and asks before a BDNS or BOE month load.

plugins.name: forja-cost-guard
plugins.description: Mod for forja: asks before a GPU rental, shows the running cost, reminds to clean up.

plugins.name: digest-guard
plugins.description: Mod for ai-digest: keeps mailbox identifiers out of site/ and Gmail tools read-only.

plugins.name: mcp-inspector
plugins.description: Mod for mcp-lab: a pane of MCP tool calls with error codes and a personal-data flag.

plugins.name: jev-status
plugins.description: Mod: local-jev up or down in the status line, and /jev-start.

plugins.name: pipeline-pane
plugins.description: Mod: a pane showing where a claude-pipeline /ship run stands.
